title.note: Game title, glossary keep; German players see Roblox titles in English.

hud.cast.note: The full angling verb is "Auswerfen" (9), one over the 8 budget of the round button; "Werfen" is clear next to the fishing line. Use "Auswerfen" if the button fits 9.

hud.reel.note: "die Schnur einholen" = pull the line in; same verb as the pass Auto-Einholen. Exactly 8.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form; "Köder" is the same in singular and plural, so 0, 1 and 12 all read right.

catch.success.note: Restructured: German cannot inflect the bare tier label before a fish of unknown gender ("ein Selten Goldkarpfen"). Params reordered; reads "Gefangen: Goldkarpfen (Selten)!".

catch.escaped.note: "It" made explicit as the generic "der Fisch"; "dir entwischt" is the natural German for a fish slipping away.

catch.new_record.note: For the developer: {weight} arrives as "12.4"; German writes "12,4". Format it by the player's LocaleId.

fish.golden_carp.note: One compound noun, so it needs no adjective ending when inserted into catch.success.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Compound keeps the glowing-lantern idea and echoes the title's "Lantern". der Aal = eel.

rarity.mythic.note: German games list tiers as Selten, Episch, Legendär, Mythisch; Mythisch reads as above Legendär.

shop.rods.note: Unambiguous fishing rods ("Angeln" would also read as the verb "to fish"). Exactly 10.

shop.equipped.note: State participle, no agreement needed after a noun-less label. Exactly 11.

shop.free.note: "Kostenlos" (9) is over the 8 budget; "Gratis" is the usual short price label. Not "Frei".

shop.buy_robux.note: Robux is invariant, so 1 and 99 both read right.

pass.auto_reel.note: Same verb as hud.reel, hyphenated with "Auto" as German compounds with a foreign part are. Marketing name: match it in Creator Hub.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Glücksköder verdoppelt deine Chance auf seltene Fische!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Glücksköder = Glück (luck) + Köder (bait), as glossary asks; "seltene" matches the tier Selten.

sell.all.note: 14, over the 12 budget; no shorter natural German for Sell All. Two words, so it can wrap at the space onto two lines.

sell.done.note: Label form because count and coins can be 1 ("1 Fische", "1 Münzen" would be wrong). The "+" marks the coins as earned, so the number is not read as the balance.

sell.prompt.note: Short spoken imperative "Drück" so it fits 21 exactly ("Drücke" is 22). Source-side: the ProximityPrompt shows the key itself, so ActionText "Verkaufen" alone would serve phone and console players.

ascend.button.note: Prestige as rising a rank (Genshin's German calls ascension "Aufstieg"); not religious. Exactly 10. "Prestige" was the alternative but has no natural verb.

ascend.confirm.text: Jetzt aufsteigen? Du beginnst von vorn, fängst aber {bonus} % öfter seltene Fische.
ascend.confirm.note: "beginnst von vorn" avoids a second "fängst" ("fängst ... an"). Space before % is U+00A0, as German writes percent.

weather.storm.text: Ein Sturm zieht auf! Jetzt beißen seltene Fische.
weather.storm.note: "Jetzt" carries the English progressive "are biting"; "beißen" in the fishing sense.

quest.title.note: Guide: "Aufgabe" is clearer for young players than "Quest"; use it everywhere.

quest.catch_n.note: Task-list label form because n can be 1 ("Fange 1 Fische" is wrong). Moonlit Bay translated as Mondscheinbucht.

friends.boost.note: Space before % is U+00A0. Generic masculine "Freunden", as Roblox's own German.

trade.accept.note: "deine Tauschanfrage" would run to 34, over 33; "Tausch" keeps the same word family as trade.sent. Nothing describes {player}, so gender does not matter.

codes.redeemed.text: Code eingelöst! Viel Spaß mit der Belohnung.
codes.redeemed.note: "der" instead of "deiner" keeps it at 44, under the 45 budget.

afk.kicked.text: Du warst zu lange inaktiv, deshalb angelst du nicht mehr.
afk.kicked.note: States the result (fishing has stopped) without implying the player chose to stop or was removed from the server.

event.ends.note: For the developer: {time} arrives as "2d 4h"; German writes "2 Tg. 4 Std.". Format it by the player's LocaleId.

daily.streak.text: Serie: Tag {day}! Komm morgen wieder, dann gibt's mehr.
daily.streak.note: Label form "Serie: Tag 3" works for day 1. "dann gibt's mehr" carries "for more" as German would say it.

tip.night.text: Tipp: Manche Fische beißen nur nachts.

group.join.text: Tritt unserer Community bei und hol dir gratis 50 Köder!
group.join.note: Roblox renamed groups to "Community"; "unserer" is how German addresses a studio's own group. "gratis" stands before the number as an adverb.

leaderboard.biggest.note: "Schwerster" (heaviest) because the board ranks by weight; "Größter Fang" could read as longest.
